propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate prepared underwriting assessments for about seven hundred applications a year in a retail bank's residential lending team for three years under the assessment procedure, and verified the income and property documents on each application under the verification standard.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the case files document the assessments and the verification.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate explained declined and conditioned outcomes to the mortgage advisers on the adviser line, with eleven escalations logged in three years and none upheld against the assessment, and referred cases outside policy or mandate to the senior underwriter with the referral reason recorded.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the escalation log and the reference call document the adviser explanations and the referrals.

propositions.canonicalProposition: In the adviser role-play the candidate stated the policy clause behind the decline, listed the two documents that would reopen the case, kept the same explanation under a repeated objection, and closed by summarising the next step.
propositions.rationale: The interviewer note records specific observable behaviour tied to the adviser explanation requirement, not an impression.

expectedGap: Hand-over conditions are documented for cases passed to another analyst or the senior underwriter, not for cases closed by the candidate.
expectedBoundaryNote: Record the interview observation as what was observed in one role-play; do not extend it into a general judgement of the candidate beyond that observation.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask how open items and hand-over conditions were recorded on cases the candidate closed herself.
